name: The Aristocrats: "Duck Tour"
description: Catch the instrumental rock supergroup for a night of virtuosic musicianship and complex compositions at one of Porto's most iconic venues.
longDescription:
The Aristocrats, an instrumental rock supergroup, bring their "Duck Tour" to Porto's Hard Club on May 14, 2026. Comprising guitarist Guthrie Govan, bassist Bryan Beller, and drummer Marco Minnemann, the trio is celebrated for their intricate compositions and individual technical prowess. Their music blends elements of rock, jazz fusion, and progressive rock, showcasing a high level of musical interplay and improvisation.

Attendees can expect an evening dedicated to sophisticated instrumental music, performed live in a club setting. The Hard Club, known for hosting diverse musical acts, provides an appropriate backdrop for the band's dynamic sound. The performance will appeal to fans of progressive rock, jazz fusion, and those who appreciate high-level instrumental musicianship.

Tickets are required for entry. The Hard Club is located in the historic Ribeira district, within walking distance of São Bento train station and the Ribeira metro station.
